credit: © NASA — Apollo 15 LRV traverse (Hadley–Apennine, Jul–Aug 1971; ~28 km over three EVAs). The route connects published traverse-station coordinates at the base of the Apennine Front / Hadley Delta — St. George crater (Station 2), Elbow crater (Station 1), the LM 'Falcon', Dune crater (Station 4) and Spur crater (Station 7) — from Wikipedia and the-moon.us crater positions. Station-waypoint approximation fanning from the LM to the front; the fully surveyed LROC track is a future upgrade (Apollo 17 uses the complete USGS mapped traverse).
